Army Defuses Five Landmines Along LoC in Poonch

The Army's Bomb Disposal Squad defused five landmines discovered along the Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch district. The mines were destroyed through controlled explosions. Officials indicated that heavy rainfall could potentially dislodge mines and move them into areas where they would pose a greater risk.
